description: This file defines an interface 'JsonArrayBuilder' in Java, which provides a fluent API for building JSON arrays. It includes methods for adding, setting, removing, and retrieving various types of values (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue) in a mutable builder pattern, allowing chained calls to construct JSON arrays dynamically.

classes.name: JsonArrayBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder with a fluent API for a JsonArray, allowing dynamic construction and modification of JSON array structures.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds at least one primitive or JsonValue to the JSON array being built, supporting multiple overloads for different data types.

methods.name: addIntegers
methods.description: Adds multiple Integer values to the array from an Iterable.

methods.name: addLongs
methods.description: Adds multiple Long values to the array from an Iterable.

methods.name: addDoubles
methods.description: Adds multiple Double values to the array from an Iterable.

methods.name: addBooleans
methods.description: Adds multiple Boolean values to the array from an Iterable.

methods.name: addStrings
methods.description: Adds multiple String values to the array from an Iterable.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds multiple JsonValue objects to the array from an Iterable.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Replaces the value at a specified index with a new primitive or JsonValue, with overloads for different data types.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional<JsonValue> at a specific index in the array.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an element by index or by value from the array.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates the final JsonArray object containing all added values.
